verdict.rationale: The pack never documents AI-generated insights or suggestions from the user's data inside GrowthBook. The 'Insights dashboards' (docs-54) are not described as AI-generated. The AI Visual Editor is a variant-creation feature, not data analysis. The MCP server connects external AI tools rather than providing in-product AI insights, so all of this is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
